title.en: Discrete vector error filtering and current feedback
title.zh: 离散矢量误差滤波与电流反馈

summary: Evaluate a device-neutral sampled ten-channel error filter with proportional, integral and filtered-derivative state, an 11x10 current map, feed-forward addition and enable hold/reset branches.

capability: Discrete vector error filtering and current feedback
Simulate the declared sampled ten-channel feedback state and mapped current output.
operation: reference, measurement, feed-forward current and controller -> current outputs and state trace
discovery.model: Ten-channel proportional/integral/filtered-derivative state with forward-Euler integration and an 11x10 linear feedback map.
discovery.geometry: Device-neutral vectors: ten measured/reference channels and eleven current outputs; no spatial or magnetic geometry is reconstructed.
discovery.boundary: Disabled samples output feed-forward current and hold PID/feedback state; a disabled-to-enabled transition resets integrator/filter state before evaluation.

identity.relation: sampled reference/measurement vectors and controller state to mapped current feedback and trace
identity.direction: inputs, controller -> total_current_A, feedback_current_A, pid_components, error_T and state_trace
identity.definition: Compute error=reference-measurement; evaluate P/I/filtered-D terms when enabled; apply the effective 11x10 map; add feed-forward current; and update or hold state according to the enable branch.
identity.model: Discrete sampled PID/filter feedback primitive with forward-Euler integrator and first-order derivative filter.
identity.geometry: Device-neutral vector relation with ten error channels, thirty ordered PID components and eleven current outputs; no spatial geometry.
identity.coordinates: Reference and measured channels use tesla, feed-forward/feedback/total currents use amperes, and sample times use seconds.
identity.boundary: The public relation covers the declared typed sampled path with interpolation disabled and exact observation times; nonzero internal reset is outside the declared branch.
assumptions: The controller parameters and signal arrays share one ten-channel/eleven-output layout.
The coefficient matrix is applied after multiplication by coefficient_scale.
The relation is a numerical sampled-state primitive; it does not establish a stable closed loop or a physical device controller.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Sampled input mapping carrying input_time_s, observation_time_s and reference, measurement, feed-forward and enable signals.
inputs.constraints: reference_T and measured_T are [n,10], feedforward_current_A is [n,11], enable is binary [n], and observation_time_s equals input_time_s for interpolation-off mode.

inputs.name: controller
inputs.description: Sampled P/I/D/filter gains, map, sample period and initial state mapping.
inputs.constraints: P, I, D and N_per_s have ten entries; coefficient_matrix_unscaled is [11,10]; initial integrator/filter states have ten entries; internal controls follow the declared binary/reset path.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Mapping containing schema, time_s, values and state_trace.
outputs.units: mixed T, A, s and controller state units
outputs.constraints: values contains total_current_A [n,11], feedback_current_A [n,11], pid_components [n,30] in P1,I1,D1 order and error_T [n,10]; state_trace records reset and pre/post integrator/filter states.

preconditions: The caller supplies aligned finite sampled arrays and a finite controller mapping.
The caller accepts interpolation-off exact-time semantics and the declared ten-channel/eleven-output layout.
supported: Finite sampled enable/hold/reset sequences on the declared parameter path.
Independent source-free evaluation of the discrete state and current map.
excluded: Native MATLAB/Simulink execution or model parity beyond the retained source/replay evidence.
Closed-loop stability, convergence, actuator limits, plant dynamics, calibration or device-specific geometry.
Parameter-resolution and malformed-input coverage beyond the direct checks.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises TypeError or ValueError for non-mapping inputs, missing signals, wrong shapes, nonfinite values, nonbinary enable/internal controls, invalid sample timing, negative filter rates or nonzero internal_reset.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NumPy conversion and arithmetic errors propagate; no fallback controller or interpolation path is selected.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this is a finite sampled pass with no iterative solve. Closed-loop convergence is outside the relation.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No result mapping is returned after validation or sampled-state failure.

example.description: Run the supplied 121-sample device-neutral fixture through the sampled feedback state.
example.code:
from pathlib import Path
import json
from scirel.closures import simulate_discrete_vector_feedback
root = Path('tests/fixtures/closures/discrete_vector_feedback/evidence')
result = simulate_discrete_vector_feedback(json.loads((root/'fixtures/feedback-input.json').read_text()), json.loads((root/'source-defaults.json').read_text()))
assert result['values']['total_current_A'][40] == result['values']['total_current_A'][40]
assert len(result['time_s']) == 121
example.expected: The bounded fixture returns 121 samples with eleven total-current outputs per sample; disabled samples retain feed-forward output and state.

scope: Four direct tests cover fixture shapes, source/replay equality, independent reimplementation against the saved trace, disabled hold/rising reset and nonbinary enable rejection.
The incoming supplement binds 12,463 source/replay numeric scalars, equal result/state files and complete member/license hashes.
The public test fixture preserves the source result and state trace bytes used by the direct comparison.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded source-fidelity partial for the declared sampled adapter path. Native Simulink, parameter-resolution discrimination, broader malformed inputs, physical calibration, closed-loop convergence/stability, human scientific acceptance, rights acceptance and release remain unestablished.
known_limitations: The implementation reproduces the declared typed fixture path and does not model a plant, actuator saturation or magnetic geometry.
Disabled and rising-enable behavior is explicit state semantics, not evidence of a stable controller.
The source/replay evidence is an adapter transcription comparison; native Simulink execution remains NOT_RUN.
License texts are retained under licenses/discrete-vector-feedback; rights acceptance remains a separate decision.
